- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh:372-378 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The reporter sends the event file's `.pull_request.head.sha` as `payload.head_sha`, but `verify_run` (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:9528-9530) compares it against the Actions API run `head_sha`, which these reviewers say is the merge commit for `pull_request` runs, so `verify_run` raises "run head mismatch".
  WHY: Both reviewers rated this BLOCKER and cite incident run 42974302609 (head_sha 5c23924... vs PR #534 head 4cef4f7...) plus the synthetic test at tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:164-177 / :171-176 that hides the defect, so Goal 1 of #9250 is not achieved; anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this claim in its pass-1 notes (a run's `head_sha` is the PR head and `GITHUB_SHA` is the merge commit).
- PR body, commit messages | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The PR body and commit messages contain auto-close keywords (Fixes, resolved) referencing orchestrator-tracking issue #2734.
  WHY: This violates §21 and the lint-pr-body-auto-close CI check fails, which blocks the merge (BLOCKER); anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash refuted it as fixture output from tests/test_lint_pr_body_auto_close.py:464, :489.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh:360-435 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The run-head override (`RUN_HEAD_SHA` → `--run-head-sha`) also applies to the `identical_failure_cap` report, so the marker lookup keys on the event head instead of the gate head (`needs.gate.outputs.head_sha`) that the counted failure markers were stamped with.
  WHY: When the event head differs from the gate head, `_autofix_failure_run_refs` finds no counted markers and `run_refs` shrinks to the cap run alone, which has no failed job, so the failure evidence is lost. Severity disagreement: google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite rated it MAJOR and the other three rated it NIT. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash refuted it, saying the gate head is `github.event.pull_request.head.sha` (review_autofix.yml:647 → :335). Suggested fix: add `[ "${FAILURE_REASON}" != "identical_failure_cap" ]` to the line-362 guard.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh:358-379 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The event-name predicate at line 370 accepts only `pull_request`, and the comment at lines 358-359 excludes `pull_request_target` on an incorrect premise, which contradicts the issue's approach and the shipped agents.d/changelog docs.
  WHY: A consumer whose wrapper fires on `pull_request_target` silently falls back to the PR head, and the documented contract does not match the implementation (MAJOR).
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:job tests-hooks-and-orchestrator | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: CI is red on head 41e8562 (the `lint` aggregate fails via tests-hooks-and-orchestrator, run 43052745706). The failure does not map to any hunk in this PR, and the real failing assertion (the last test, `test_main_exit_codes`) is cut off past the log tail.
  WHY: The merge stays blocked whatever the diff does. The `::error::[lint_pr_body_auto_close] ... #2734` lines are fixture output, and the blamed tests (test_review_autofix_provider_outage_contract.py:121-127, test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py) read no changed file. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR: reproduce the job and fix it or reclassify it as inherited.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_autofix_report.sh:370-378 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The event head read uses `jq -r ... | head -1 | tr ...`, which keeps only the first line of a malformed or multi-line value.
  WHY: No runtime failure, because the 40-hex `is_valid_sha` check rejects garbage (NIT, included for completeness).
